variables.name: CW_DEPLOYMENT_ENV
variables.purpose: Sanitized deployment environment label

variables.name: RENDER_GIT_COMMIT
variables.purpose: Exact deployed Git SHA supplied automatically by Render

variables.name: PORT
variables.purpose: Render-assigned public web-service bind port

variables.name: CW_GATEWAY_RESOURCE_URL
variables.purpose: Canonical OAuth protected-resource and public MCP URL

variables.name: CW_GATEWAY_DATABASE
variables.purpose: Absolute SQLite path on the attached staging disk

variables.name: CW_GATEWAY_HOST
variables.purpose: Container bind address

variables.name: CW_GATEWAY_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.purpose: DNS-rebinding allowlist for canonical and Render staging hosts

variables.name: CW_GATEWAY_DOCUMENTATION_URL
variables.purpose: Public resource documentation advertised to MCP clients

variables.name: CW_OAUTH_ISSUER_URL
variables.purpose: Exact HTTPS Auth0 tenant issuer

variables.name: CW_OAUTH_JWKS_URL
variables.purpose: Auth0 HTTPS JSON Web Key Set endpoint

variables.name: CW_OAUTH_WORKSPACE_CLAIM
variables.purpose: Namespaced token claim containing the CW workspace identifier

variables.name: CW_OAUTH_ALGORITHMS
variables.purpose: Explicit asymmetric JWT verification algorithms

variables.name: CW_PAIRING_WEB_CLIENT_ID
variables.purpose: Auth0 public application client identifier for browser pairing confirmation

variables.name: CW_PAIRING_WEB_REDIRECT_URI
variables.purpose: OAuth callback URL for the gateway-hosted pairing page

variables.name: CW_PAIRING_SESSION_SECRET
variables.purpose: Gateway-only HMAC secret for short-lived browser pairing session cookies

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
variables.purpose: Maximum requests per authenticated principal per minute

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_DEVICE_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
variables.purpose: Maximum requests routed to one paired device per minute

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_PAIRING_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
variables.purpose: Maximum public pairing requests per source and device per minute

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_CONCURRENT_PER_DEVICE
variables.purpose: Maximum in-flight routed operations per local device

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_REQUEST_BYTES
variables.purpose: Maximum public MCP or pairing request size

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_AGENT_MESSAGE_BYTES
variables.purpose: Maximum signed local-agent message size

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.purpose: Gateway wait deadline for one routed operation

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_AGENT_IDLE_SECONDS
variables.purpose: Agent availability threshold

variables.name: CW_LIMIT_COMPLETED_CACHE
variables.purpose: Bounded in-memory completed response replay cache
